params.caption: 🎮 Rockstar explains what GTA 6 leaves out: no Disney parody, no fake internet, no cheating on Lucia Rockstar keeps opening up about GTA 6's design choices. A producer says there is no Disney World parody for an "obvious reason", adding that building one would take a lot of work. The satirical in-game websites of GTA 5 are gone too, replaced by social media and phone apps because a web "didn't feel necessary". And Jason can't cheat on Lucia with Mandy or strippers, as Rockstar felt it wouldn't fit the couple's story. 🕒 Nov 19, 2026 · 16:20 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: VGC · Eurogamer · PC Gamer 👥 @RockstarGames 🤔 Good calls or missed chances?
